test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code, P + Q means 'Q is the son of P'; P @ Q means 'Q is the daughter of P'; P $ Q means 'Q is the brother of P'; P % Q means 'P is the father of Q' and P # Q means 'P is the mother of Q'.

Which of the following is true?

options.text: C @ D $ F % G means G is the grandson of C.
A + B $ C % D means A is the maternal grandfather of D.
K + L $ M @ N means N is the granddaughter of K.
G % H # K $ L means L is the son-in-law of G.

solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36599e00c5f3cd5eceb3f9cbbc632b5ff566dcb577e6b56253f1be4781571713.png] 

Let us first decode the given symbol and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 @
 $
 %
 #
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Daughter
 Brother
 Father
 Mother
 
 

Option 1) C @ D $ F % G means G is the grandson of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992115d34122cb7bf23bb78a5ea643a8af7d6e0072011ff59033cf599be86ebe.png] 

False, here the gender of **G **is not clear, So we can't say that **G **is the grandson of **C.**

Option 2) A + B $ C % D means A is the maternal grandfather of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec2871039ffcd3f0c1ecdd97a418e05d3a38b5e0613fcdfe7fe1b162d7beeadc.png] 

False, here the gender of **A **is not clear, So we can't say that **A **is grandfather of D.

Option 3) K + L $ M @ N means N is the granddaughter of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cbdc33fc3a85df2f71c29e296669d3eba6a18c4f534e97de01c4774e4165e6c.png] 

**True, **here the gender of **N **is clear she is a female, So **N **is the granddaughter of **K **is correct.

Option 4) G % H # K $ L means L is the son-in-law of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d898196e18ccf688af25b3283a6e15641033c7605c342f930856717702324ff5.png] 

False, here **L **is not a son-in-law of **G. **Because **L **is the grandson of **G.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
